read-ai-vs-otter-ai.2: The core difference is focus. Otter AI produces a live, searchable transcript, while Read AI produces meeting reports with engagement and talk-time analytics plus a personal meeting coach. Both summarize and list action items.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.7: Picture a 10-person team on annual billing: Otter Pro comes to $1,000 a year, and Read AI Pro to $1,800. Full breakdown: [Read AI pricing](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-pricing).
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.8: For individuals on annual billing ($8.33 a month), Otter is not expensive at all. The jump comes with the Business plan, which costs $30 per user per month on monthly billing. Teams often end up there because Pro caps each conversation at 90 minutes and 1,200 minutes a month.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.10: Frequent short calls favour Otter's free plan: 300 minutes a month, up to 30 minutes each. A few long calls favour Read AI's: 5 meetings a month, up to 1 hour each.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.12: On apps, Read AI lists native versions on 4 platforms: Windows, macOS, Android and iOS, all available on the free plan. Otter takes a lighter approach, with a browser-based web app plus iOS and Android apps, and a meeting agent that joins Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.14: With clear English audio and 1 speaker at a time, both tools are accurate enough; crosstalk, accents and poor microphones trip up each of them. Where they differ is in fixing mistakes. You get more correction tools in Otter: custom vocabulary (5 terms on Basic) and team vocabulary on Pro.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.16: Premium integrations come with Read AI Pro, 7 of them: Notion, Confluence, Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Zapier and webhooks. On Otter, Pro adds Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier, with an API and webhooks on Enterprise.

read-ai-vs-otter-ai.21: We go deeper on Fireflies in [Otter vs Fireflies vs Fathom](https://lynkk.ai/blog/otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai).
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.23: Languages matter too. Lynkk supports 17 of them, including Hindi and Hinglish. Free covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each, and Pro costs $15 a month.
